# HTTP/TLS/TCP overhead model (generated by run_http.py)

Batches: 204, mean 31.1 events. Mean body: V1 gzip-1 3464 B, MTB2 zstd-19+dict 669 B (incl. 2 B frame prefix). Mean V1 response body 1382 B (not compressed today), MTB2 ack ~10 B.

## Header bytes

- HTTP/1.1 V1 request headers (with Expect: 100-continue): 258 B
- HTTP/1.1 V1 request headers (without Expect): 236 B
- HTTP/1.1 V2 request headers (Host + Authorization + Content-Length only): 141 B
- HTTP/1.1 response headers: V1-style 149 B, minimal 76 B
- HTTP/2 HPACK request header block, requests 1..3 on one connection: V1 [104, 12, 12] B, V2 [76, 10, 10] B (+9 B HEADERS frame + 9 B DATA frame each)

## Per-request totals on the wire (app bytes + TLS records + TCP/IP), warm connection

| scenario | up B/req | down B/req | up B/event | down B/event | body share of up |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| V1 today, warm HTTP/1.1 keep-alive | 3974 | 1709 | 127.7 | 54.9 | 87% |
| V1 body + V1 headers, warm HTTP/2 (steady state) | 3724 | 1600 | 119.7 | 51.4 | 93% |
| MTB2, warm HTTP/1.1 | 936 | 212 | 30.1 | 6.8 | 71% |
| MTB2, warm HTTP/2 (steady state) | 823 | 166 | 26.4 | 5.3 | 81% |

## Connection setup (paid once per connection)

- TCP handshake ~192 B (3 segments incl. options), +1 RTT
- TLS 1.3 full handshake, measured (results/tls.txt): client->server 302-319 B (X25519) or 1500-1728 B (X25519MLKEM768 hybrid, now default in OpenSSL 3.5+/Chrome); server->client 2817-5163 B (cert chain dominates)
- TLS 1.3 PSK resumption: no certificate chain; ESTIMATE 400-700 B up, 200-400 B down [estimate, not measured]
- TLS 1.3 0-RTT / QUIC 0-RTT: request rides in the first flight; replayable, so only for idempotent requests (RFC 8446 8, RFC 9001 9.2) [source]

MTB2 single batch on a COLD connection (full TLS, classic X25519): ~1438 B up / ~4212 B down vs warm 936 / 212. Body is 12% of all bytes moved.

Single-event request: MTB2 body 116 B vs V1 body 495 B; HTTP/1.1 V2 headers alone 141 B.
